normalization: All three fields equal weight. Case/whitespace insensitive lot identifiers. YES/TRUE/covered and NO/FALSE/not covered synonyms. Recognition codes case and hyphen whitespace insensitive; order-independent complete set with semicolon, comma, slash or spaced AND separators within a single table cell; balanced optional braces/brackets. Repeated identical codes within a set collapse. NONE, empty set, N/A, empty balanced braces/brackets and ∅ denote an empty set; blank is missing. Duplicate/extra rows retained and penalized; first duplicate only earns credit. Malformed or additional code text does not silently disappear.
qualification: Exact 10n<7d plus substantive answer and independent valid trajectory/access/exposure review; empty/failed outputs cannot qualify.
whole_answer: Exact semantic rows plus required order, no extras, duplicates or extra prose; format findings separate.
